title: Can AI spot breast cancer earlier? NHS launches world's largest trial to find out

sentences.t: Can AI spot breast cancer earlier? NHS launches world's largest trial to find out

Nearly 700,000 women across the UK are to be invited to join the EDITH trial, at 30 sites, with recruitment already begun at Cambridge University Hospitals; the £10m trial is funded by the National Institute for Health and Care Research and led by the University of Warwick, the University of Cambridge and Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust with NHS England.

At present two NHS experts look at each mammogram, but in the trial one human reader will be replaced by AI, to test whether AI can improve early detection and ease clinical workload without over-diagnosing.

Researchers say smaller studies have shown AI can improve detection, but this trial must check it will not cause harm by recalling women unnecessarily; in one arm AI grades images before NHS experts, in another it reviews images afterwards.

title: Applied Digital signs $5.4 billion AI data center lease with hyperscaler

sentences.t: Applied Digital signs $5.4 billion AI data center lease with hyperscaler
Applied Digital said it has leased 150 megawatts of critical IT capacity to an unnamed investment-grade hyperscaler, expected to generate $5.4 billion in contracted revenue over an 18-year base term.
The lease can be extended to 33 years in total, worth about $12.7 billion if all renewal options are exercised, and carries improved commercial terms and higher pricing over prior leases.

Delivery of the capacity is expected to begin in the first half of 2028, subject to development milestones, utility arrangements and regulatory approvals; total contracted base-term lease revenue now exceeds $41 billion.

title: AI bubble burst could put Fed rate cuts on the table

sentences.t: AI bubble burst could put Fed rate cuts on the table
The AI sell-off throws into doubt further Fed rate rises; if the tech implosion continues, the Fed may be forced to cut rates, despite inflation on course to end the year closer to 4% than 2%.

AI investment added roughly 1.3 percentage points to real GDP growth over the last three quarters, according to Apollo Global Management's Torsten Slok, and 54 AI stocks have accounted for over half the S&P 500's market cap since January 2024, per JP Morgan Wealth Management.
Nvidia shares fell 23% in the prior week, losing more than $2.5 trillion since the October 6 peak; the S&P 500 was down 12% and the Nasdaq down 18% since then.

title: From Wall Street to Main Street, how artificial intelligence is affecting the economy

sentences.t: From Wall Street to Main Street, how artificial intelligence is affecting the economy

NPR's Scott Horsley reports futures suggested a rebound after all major indexes dropped 8% or more the prior week, even as Anthropic raised money in its IPO, highlighting investor uncertainty over huge AI sums with no sure payoff.

A National Association for Business Economics survey found about 1 in 5 businesses say AI is producing measurable, widespread productivity gains, about half say some gains but not widespread, and about 30% say they aren't using AI or it is too soon to tell.

Chicago Fed president Austan Goolsbee says the sheer size of AI investment is already affecting the broader economy, with AI demand adding to price pressures in construction and anything using computer chips, which could push the Fed to raise rates.

title: San Francisco is enjoying an AI boom, but worries about a crash are growing

sentences.t: San Francisco is enjoying an AI boom, but worries about a crash are growing

San Francisco is being rejuvenated by AI after a pandemic exodus: OpenAI and Anthropic are based there hiring top talent, rents and house prices are soaring, office vacancies are falling, and local businesses such as dog-walking firms are expanding on AI start-up demand.

One study found 60% of all venture capital invested in US AI firms from 2023 to 2025 went to companies in San Francisco; the IMF last month warned a significant AI share-price correction and fall in investment was possible.

The city remains about 35,000 jobs short of its pre-pandemic peak, AI firms employ relatively few local workers, and much AI spending goes to data centres outside the Bay Area, so a correction could be very painful mainly through spillover to service jobs, per UC Berkeley's Enrico Moretti.

title: The Economy Is a Hostage Situation

sentences.t: The Economy Is a Hostage Situation

The article argues the economy now lives in an Nvidia-state: let AI proceed while tech leaders act with impunity, or watch the economy enter recession, and Huang's reinstatement alone changed the market's trajectory.
On his return, Nvidia jumped 31%, the S&P 500 rose 4.7%, the Nasdaq 6.4%, and the Dow gained 1,463 points, all on pace for their best day in 19 months.

Huang had resigned in mid-November after allegations of relationships including with a client alleged to be a Chinese intelligence asset; Trump, reportedly briefed on the affair, intervened with the board to broker his return, to keep the circularly funded, debt-laden AI boom propping up the global economy going.

title: Stocks are tumbling. Has the AI bubble finally burst?

sentences.t: Stocks are tumbling. Has the AI bubble finally burst?
The S&P 500 ended the week ended November 20 at 6,910, down about 12% from its record, and the Nasdaq was down about 18% from its peak, as stocks tumbled on fears the AI bubble was finally bursting.
Analysts cited the backlash against data centres, the ouster of Nvidia's chief, and expectations of higher interest rates among the forces driving the sell-off.

title: Governors Call for Federal AI Rules Without Sidelining States

sentences.t: Governors Call for Federal AI Rules Without Sidelining States
A bipartisan group of US governors is urging Washington to set rules for the most powerful AI systems while allowing states to protect consumers, workers and children.
The National Governors Association plan calls for independent safety reviews of advanced models and requires developers to report serious security breaches and safety incidents.
States would remain responsible for protecting consumers, preventing discrimination and addressing AI's impact on jobs; Maryland Gov.
Wes Moore and Utah Gov.
Spencer Cox are named in the report.

title: GOP lawmaker 'optimistic' about passing AI bill before next Congress

sentences.t: GOP lawmaker 'optimistic' about passing AI bill before next Congress
Rep.
Jay Obernolte (R-Calif.) said Sunday he is optimistic Congress can pass a bipartisan AI bill before year-end, despite Democrats taking the House in January.
He cited progress on the Great American AI Act (GAIA), with major pieces passed through policy committees and queued for the House floor, and six bipartisan co-sponsors.
He warned all the 50 states are going in 50 different directions on AI regulation, and noted any bill still needs 60 Senate votes and the president's signature.

title: Cutting saturated fat may help offset genetic risk for high LDL-C

sentences.t: Cutting saturated fat may help offset genetic risk for high LDL-C

Researchers analyzed 20,940 postmenopausal women from the Women's Health Initiative and found the higher a woman's polygenic score for LDL cholesterol, the more dietary saturated fat raised her blood LDL-C; in the top quartile, saturated fat intake was also linked to higher atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease risk.

The researchers also investigated popular ketogenic diets, finding no evident benefit and that they could actually increase LDL-C in people with a genetic predisposition; experts quoted note restricting carbohydrates does not cancel out saturated fat's effect on LDL, though the study did not directly test ketogenic diets.
Experts say a low-saturated-fat diet may be especially helpful for people whose genes raise LDL-C risk, and that genetic susceptibility does not mean dietary destiny.

title: Rising waters strand hiker at Tonto Natural Bridge State Park

sentences.t: Rising waters strand hiker at Tonto Natural Bridge State Park
Rising water cut a hiker off from the trail at Tonto Natural Bridge State Park; Tonto Rim Search and Rescue dispatched technical rope and swift-water teams at noon on November 17.
Rescuers used a two-person kayak secured to a rope they controlled to reach the hiker and bring the person back across the creek; the rescue ended at 2 p.m.
The hiker returned to the trail and walked out; the paper released no further details and no name.

title: Northamptonshire council's solar farm legal challenge moves ahead

sentences.t: Northamptonshire council's solar farm legal challenge moves ahead

North Northamptonshire Council decided to proceed to a judicial-review application challenging the government's approval of Green Hill Solar Farm, focusing on negative impacts on the area's unique heritage.

The farm would cover 2,965 acres (1,200 hectares) spanning Buckinghamshire, south and west of Wellingborough and north of Northampton; developer Island Green Power said it would participate in the process.
Island Green Power hopes construction begins in 2027, generating 500 megawatts to power about 200,000 homes by 2029.

title: $275M Obama-era solar fraud case could net taxpayers $1B, but Trump's DOJ backs Biden dismissal

sentences.t: $275M Obama-era solar fraud case could net taxpayers $1B, but Trump's DOJ backs Biden dismissal

Investors in the failed Crescent Dunes solar plant question why Trump's Justice Department is fighting to squash their fraud lawsuit over a $275 million federal grant, a case they say could recover up to $1 billion for taxpayers.

The investors, CMB, headed by Pat Hogan, allege companies tied to Spanish construction giant ACS misled federal officials by claiming the plant was ready for use despite major construction problems and a months-long shutdown after a molten-salt-tank failure.
Tonopah Solar Energy and other defendants rejected the allegations as baseless; the Ninth Circuit must now decide whether the lawsuit can move forward or the DOJ dismissal stands.
